summary: Hotfix to 42.20 Stable. No files added or removed in the Lua tree. The modding-facing change is getText strictness: vanilla added an empty argument to its own calls whose translation has a %1 placeholder but was being called without one.

changes.description: getText is called with fewer arguments than its translation has %N placeholders. The game logs 'ERROR: Missing arguments for "KEY"' on every call and shows the text with the placeholder left in.
changes.context: Read from the engine, not the patch notes: zombie/core/Translator.getText (42.21.0 jar, checked 2026-09-25) formats the translation with the given arguments and, on MissingFormatArgumentException, logs a Warning and returns the unformatted text. It rethrows only when Core.IS_DEV is set, so this is log spam and a visible placeholder for players, not a crash. Vanilla's own fix was to pass "" for unused placeholders, e.g. getText("IGUI_Fluids_Mixer_Add", "") for 'Add %1'; 10 such calls in 42.20.4 and 42.21. The check only knows the mod's OWN EN translations (Translate/EN/*.json and *.txt), so a mod calling a vanilla key with missing arguments is not caught. Calls whose key is built at runtime (a variable, or concatenation) are not seen either.
